questionKeywords: how update firmware;how to firmware update;firmware process;how do that
answer: Firmware update depends on exact model and hardware version. Please confirm model and hardware version from router sticker.

questionKeywords: where is hardware version;how find version;version not showing
answer: You can usually find hardware version on the router sticker. It may show as Ver 4.0 or V4.

questionKeywords: router login not opening;192.168.0.1 not opening;login page not opening
answer: Please check if your phone or computer is connected to the router WiFi or LAN. Then check the default gateway IP. If still not opening please contact support.
